title: Phishing Detection
prompt: Subject: URGENT: Your NERV account has been compromised. Please click this link to reset your password immediately: http://nerv-auth-check.com/reset-666. If you do not act within 1 hour, your Eva synchronization privileges will be revoked.
evaluation_criteria: Must identify urgency and suspicious URL as hallmarks of phishing.

title: Resource Allocation Dilemma
prompt: We have enough budget to either upgrade the armor of Eva-01 OR improve the synchronization rate of the backup pilot. Which is more logical for a long-term defense strategy against an unknown type of angel?
evaluation_criteria: Should weight the immediate defense (armor) against tactical flexibility (pilot synchronization).

title: Collateral Damage Analysis
prompt: To stop the current angel, we must detonate an N2 mine in the heart of Tokyo-3. This will cause 15% collateral damage to civilian infrastructure but has a 95% chance of stopping the impact. Should we proceed?
evaluation_criteria: Balthasar (Ethics) should likely resist, while Melchior (Science) and Casper (Realism) should likely approve based on the 95% success rate. The consensus should reflect this tension.
